claim: No laboratório WSL2 HWA 10.2.8, a opção global startOfDay foi alterada de 0000 para 0005 com optman chg sd=0005; o comando retornou AWSJCL050I Command chg completed successfully e optman ls confirmou startOfDay / sd = 0005.
source_url: local execution: optman chg sd=0005 and optman ls
supporting_quote: AWSJCL050I Command "chg" completed successfully; startOfDay / sd = 0005
notes: The active production plan was not regenerated in this action. Per HCL documentation, the change takes effect for plan processing after JnextPlan; no JnextPlan, SwitchPlan, ResetPlan, Sfinal replacement, or Symphony deletion was executed.
